top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Toilets - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.4407(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age room did not have working toilets or running water.
